name: Open House
summary: A housewarming invitation where a little house builds itself, the lights come on and the front door opens
about: A housewarming invitation set in a garden at morning (or under the stars at night). The ground rises, the walls go up, the roof drops on, the windows pop in and the string lights switch on before the front door swings open and the hosts wave. Guests see the date with a live countdown, copy the address, add it to their calendar and copy a ready reply; hosts type their own details and share the link.
how: Open the page: the house builds itself and the front door opens.
Tap the windows to switch their lights, the door to open or close it, the mailbox flag and the cat in the window.
Use Add to calendar to save a calendar file, and Copy address to copy where the party is.
Pick Yes, Maybe or Can't make it, add your name and guests, then Copy my reply to send it to the hosts.
In Make your invitation, fill in hosts, address, date, time, a note and the house colour.
Copy the link (or Share it) and send it to your guests.
